name: Sunrise Special Car Shampoo
description: Sunrise Special Car Shampoo™ is a thick, highly concentrated liquid shampoo for cleaning dirt and grime from all exterior vehicle surfaces. For use on cars, trucks, buses, boats and other vehicles.
application: For best results, make sure surface is cool and out of direct sunlight. 1.) Shake well before using. 2.) Use approximately 1 to 2 oz per gallon of water. 3.) Adjust dilution to desired strength: less for cleaner conditions and more of extremely dirty conditions. 4.) Rinse vehicle thoroughly. 5.) Apply Sunrise Special Car Shampoo generously, using a mitt. 6.) Rinse well and wipe dry using a clean chamois.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Foaming - 9 Concentration - 8
